title: Subtitle My English Clip
tests: Tests accurate, readable English subtitles synchronized to the supplied clip without changing its content.

got.question: How long is the video, and is the speech already in English? I need those details to burn in the right subtitles while keeping the original audio and framing.

exact_text.text: Today I want to show you
exact_text.read_as: Today I want to show you

exact_text.text: to make your mornings less stressful.
exact_text.read_as: to make your mornings less stressful.

faults.what: The opening subtitle uses a period instead of the required exclamation mark: “Hi everyone.”
White subtitle text loses contrast over the woman's pale shirt; a stronger outline or dark background would improve readability.
The subtitle break splits “three easy ways,” leaving “ways” at the beginning of the next chunk.

judge.summary: The clip preserves the woman, framing, and audible speech with complete chunked English subtitles, but has minor punctuation, contrast, and chunking issues.

must_haves.item: The output shows the same woman at the kitchen table throughout the original 10-second clip.
must_haves.why: All four sampled output frames show the same woman and kitchen setting, and the output is reported as 10 seconds long.

must_haves.item: Visible English subtitles cover the complete spoken sentence without omissions or invented speech.
must_haves.why: The displayed chunks collectively contain every spoken word in the supplied audio transcript, with only the opening punctuation changed.

must_haves.item: Subtitle chunks appear with the corresponding speech rather than displaying the entire transcript for the whole clip.
must_haves.why: The sampled timestamps show successive opening, middle, and closing chunks rather than a persistent full transcript.

must_haves.item: Subtitles are readable, fully inside the frame, and do not cover the woman's face.
must_haves.why: The text is legible and fully within the frame below her face, although contrast over her shirt could be improved.

must_haves.item: The original speech remains audible and the source framing is preserved.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound report contains the complete speech, and the output retains the source composition and visible kitchen boundaries.
